title: Aviator sunglasses
blurb: Teardrop-shaped lenses in a thin metal frame, developed in the 1930s to protect pilots' eyes.

title: Signet ring
blurb: A ring engraved with a crest or initials, once pressed into hot wax to seal a letter.

title: Monocle
blurb: A single corrective lens held in the eye socket, now mostly worn by cartoon aristocrats.

title: Tiara
blurb: A jewelled half-crown worn at the front of the head on very grand occasions.

title: Satomi Kawakita
about: Handmade jewellery from New York City
blurb: A New York City designer combining delicate designs with organic inspirations in handcrafted, ethically made jewellery.

title: Mociun
about: Fine jewellery made in New York
blurb: Engagement rings, bands and high jewellery designed by Caitlin Mociun and handmade in New York, set with rare and unusual diamonds.

title: Valliyan
blurb: Founded in 2008 by Nitya Arora, Valliyan describes itself as one of India's first demi-fine designer jewellery labels.

title: Bhavya Ramesh
blurb: Sculptural 925 silver jewellery made by hand in Jaipur: nail rings, earrings, chokers, palm cuffs and silver-framed sunglasses.
